Reuses unchanged original Rust lower_face scalar inverse; canonical original/derived preview/export/history, UI and target-recomputed scalar presets. No numerical or photographic acceptance.

static_checks.payload_trailing_whitespace: none; pre-existing workflow_ports.py blank EOF unchanged
static_checks.rust_reuse: Existing core/lower_face, native boundary and packaging remain unchanged. No new Rust solver or binary claimed. Existing Rust fixtures not run.
static_checks.independent_source_review: Source review found and corrected disabled/other-source compatibility recovery blocker; exact applied readback confirmed. Geometry, inverse bridge, parameters, source support and atomic publication appear source-consistent, not numerical/runtime acceptance.

integration_map.state_and_shared_native: chin_length_state.py / chin_length_native.py; strict version1 scalar, explicit coexistence helper and fixed-tail bridge to already-packaged original Rust inverse
integration_map.source_geometry: chin_length_runtime.py / chin_length_people.py; actual below-all-40-lips interval and full lower oval, source-owned evidence and protected prefix pullback
integration_map.canonical_owner: people_algorithms.py / people_render_runtime.py; separate operation after chin shape, original first four slots and common sampler preserved
integration_map.safe_replacement: people_edit.py and new UI; complete atomic old-zero plus independently chosen new amount, source/scope/history fences, no automatic reinterpretation
integration_map.conflict_recovery: A.recipes remains readable; validate_compatibility checks enabled current-source candidate faces and every admitted render entry. Disabled/foreign dormant intent does not block local recovery. Shared affected parked sources still validate through complete rendering.
integration_map.ui: ui/src/chinLength / exact RetouchPanel leaf / native capability / people labels; truthful signed legacy readings and explicit old-only/new-only reset
integration_map.presets: chin_length_scope.py / people_scope.py / scope.py / workflow_ports.py / presetModel.ts; target-owned scalar reconstruction, legacy conflicts refuse without reset
integration_map.requirements: IMPLEMENTATION.md / NUMERICAL-CONTRACT.md / registry extensions / historical partial route inventory

limitations: Original below-lip visual length interpretation, not clinical anatomy, complete segmentation, AI/3D or proprietary equivalence.
Existing wrong legacy small_chin topology remains byte-identical; its larger historical 收下巴 behavior is not silently declared corrected. Explicit new choice is required for replacement.
Adjacent neck/background moves; source lip pinning is not global invariance after prior composed geometry. Conservative evidence/neighbor guards can refuse.
Shared bounded f64 inverse retains underflow/stagnation and coordinate-roundoff limits; small accepted deltas can disappear in subtraction or downstream float32 map.
An externally restored invalid graph with multiple conflicting enabled faces on one source still needs a separate explicit multi-face recovery facility. No partially compatible render is published.
Generic derived presets remain guarded; explicit reviewed people transfer rebuilds each target source and refuses conflicts without silently zeroing legacy intent.
Broader alpha/HDR and remaining facial-family requirements, clinical/curvature claims and photographic acceptance remain unfinished.
